Calculator.faqSubtitle: A few answers about your estimate
Calculator.faq1Q: Is this the complete landed cost?
Calculator.faq1A: The total only includes the import fees listed in the breakdown. It excludes the vehicle price, freight, insurance and other unlisted costs. Confirm your full budget for the specific vehicle and transport route.
Calculator.faq2Q: Can both private and business importers use it?
Calculator.faq2A: Only Kyrgyzstan offers an individual/company choice. Other pages follow the reference site’s single scope, which does not establish identical legal treatment for both identities.
Calculator.faq3Q: Why is no amount shown for some destinations?
Calculator.faq3A: All seven countries now provide reference amounts, including Russian electric cars and Kyrgyz individual/company routes. Missing inputs, dates outside the reference year or uncovered rules are identified explicitly.
Calculator.faq4Q: Will exchange rates and fees be updated?
Calculator.faq4A: The static site uses a market-rate snapshot fetched at build time and shows its data date. A failed fetch uses clearly labelled illustrative rates. Updating the snapshot requires rebuilding and publishing; you can also edit rates under More settings. Market rates may differ from customs rates.

CountryPolicies.title: {country}: policy and cost notes
CountryPolicies.referenceHint: Summarized from public reference material, pending official review. Confirm eligibility, admission rules and charges for your clearance date. Vehicle purchase, freight and insurance are outside the total.

RU.personalScope: This tool follows personal-use imports. Companies and sole traders require a separate assessment; this result does not cover them.
RU.excluded: Budget separately for vehicle transport, bonded storage, customs brokerage and registration.
RU.electric: Reference electric-car duty is 15% of customs value rather than a per-cc charge. Recycling still depends on power and age.
RU.hybrid: The reference treats hybrids through the combustion-engine duty route, using engine capacity rather than electric-car treatment.
RU.middleAge: For vehicles at least 3 but under 5 years old, reference duty is a fixed amount per cc, independent of purchase price.

KZ.serviceEstimate: The reference site includes a 400,000 KZT allowance for certification, emergency-call equipment, brokerage and storage. This is a market estimate rather than a fixed official charge.
KZ.excluded: Vehicle transport is separate. Service costs vary with the broker and storage duration.
KZ.luxury: The reference adds a 10% luxury excise above a customs value of 77,850,000 KZT. Confirm the applicable year and valuation.
KZ.electric: The reference applies zero duty and recycling charge, with lower registration bands, to electric cars; VAT usually remains payable. Confirm eligibility.
KZ.erev: The reference separates series range-extenders whose wheels are driven only by electric motors. Ordinary HEV/PHEV models must not be classified this way from their name alone.
KZ.older: Beyond 7 years, reference duty uses the higher of the percentage charge and the minimum per-cc charge.
KZ.registration: This vehicle is over 2 calendar years old and enters a higher reference registration band. Registration year bands differ from duty age measured in months.

UZ.excise: The reference material reports that passenger-car import excise was removed in August 2020, with a recycling fee charged separately. Do not add both charges.
UZ.freightBasis: Transport to the border contributes to customs value and affects duty and VAT. Including freight in a tax base does not include the freight payment in the import-fee total.
UZ.excluded: Customs brokerage, bonded storage and unlisted services require separate budgets.
UZ.condition: The reference distinguishes never-registered new cars from previously registered used cars. Low mileage alone does not establish new-car status.
UZ.electric: Reference electric-car duty is zero, but recycling charges remain. Its May 2025 schedule quotes 120 BRV up to 3 years and 210 BRV thereafter; confirm current rules.
UZ.hybrid: The reference omits the per-cc supplement for unregistered new hybrids. Used hybrids follow separate age and capacity rules.
UZ.usedFuel: For previously registered petrol/diesel cars, the reference duty is 40% of customs value plus 3 USD per cc. Confirm vehicle classification.
UZ.older: Beyond 3 years, the reference recycling charge moves to an older-car band; the increase depends on capacity and powertrain.
UZ.newFuelFresh: A never-registered combustion car up to 12 months old uses reference duty of 15% plus its per-cc supplement. Expired small-engine concessions are not applied.
UZ.newFuelOlder: A never-registered combustion car older than 12 months uses reference duty of 30% plus its per-cc supplement, distinct from the used-car schedule.

GE.taxBasis: The reference calculation uses engine capacity, calendar-year age and steering position rather than vehicle price. Keep the listed administrative charges separate from vehicle and transport costs.
GE.electric: Reference electric cars incur neither excise nor import tax, but the listed administrative charges remain.
GE.older: For non-electric cars older than 6 years, the reference excise base rate is 4.5 GEL per cc.
GE.hybridRelief: The reference reduces excise by 60% for left-hand-drive hybrids no older than 6 years.
GE.hybridNoRelief: Hybrids older than 6 years or with right-hand drive do not receive that 60% reduction in the reference.
GE.rightHand: Reference excise for right-hand-drive non-electric cars is three times the base amount.
GE.emissions: For production before 2013, check Euro 5 admission and permanent-registration requirements. Production year does not establish actual emissions certification.

AM.personalScope: For individuals, the reference material uses CCT duty, 20% VAT and environmental tax rather than the personal unified rates under Decision No. 107. Confirm applicability separately.
AM.environment: The reference environmental bands are 0% up to 5 years, 2% for 6–10, 10% for 11–15 and 20% from 16 years. Hybrids and electric cars have separate exemptions.
AM.excise: The reference material applies no excise to M1/8703 passenger cars.
AM.age: Age is approximated by calendar years. Customs may use the actual production date, especially around the 3- and 7-year boundaries.
AM.excluded: Vehicle transport, bonded storage, terminal handling, brokerage and registration are separate.
AM.electric: Reference material mentions a 2026 electric-car duty quota and VAT relief ending 2026-12-31. Quota availability, production year and eligibility need confirmation; exemption is not guaranteed.
AM.largePetrol: The reference uses 12.5% duty for petrol cars under 3 years old with engines above 2,800cc, subject to confirmation.
AM.largeHybrid: For hybrids of that age and capacity, the reference retains 15% duty rather than the 12.5% large-engine petrol band.

KG.exchange: Reference tariffs are denominated in euros. Confirm KGS conversion using the applicable National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic rate on the clearance date.
KG.excluded: Transport, bonded storage, brokerage and registration are separate. The reference material applies no recycling charge to personal-use imports.
KG.personalLimit: The reference personal-use treatment is limited to the first vehicle imported in a calendar year; later imports follow the commercial route.
KG.personalFee: The reference tool lists a 0.4% processing charge separately. The official personal unified-payment calculator may present this differently; confirm actual payment.
KG.registration: The separate 5% first-registration allowance is an estimate, excluded from import payments. The authority may use its own average market valuation.
KG.companyBroker: Commercial imports generally require a licensed customs broker; brokerage is charged separately.
KG.electricQuota: Electric and series-hybrid relief depends on quota, classification and clearance date. An earlier quota-exhaustion statement does not establish the rate today.
KG.personalFuel: For other personal-use cars, the reference unified payment depends on capacity, age and younger-car value rather than a separate petrol/diesel tariff.
KG.companyElectricYoung: The reference exempts commercial electric/series-hybrid cars up to 5 calendar years old from VAT. Confirm the exact production date and eligibility.
KG.companyElectricOld: The reference applies 12% VAT to commercial electric/series-hybrid cars over 5 calendar years old.

AL.personalScope: The reference lists zero duty and excise for individual imports. VAT and other applicable charges remain; this does not establish the same treatment for companies.
AL.exchange: Displayed rates are market references. Tax assessment should use the exchange rate accepted by Albanian Customs.
AL.excluded: Transport to Albania, Durrës port handling and customs brokerage are separate costs.
AL.luxury: Reference luxury thresholds are at least 3,000cc or 5,000,000 ALL customs value: 70,000 ALL once and 21,000 ALL annually. The annual tax is outside the one-time import total.
AL.electric: The reference excludes electric cars from capacity-based minimum valuation but still applies 20% VAT to the tax base.
AL.minimumValue: Combustion and hybrid cars have capacity-based minimum customs values. VAT may use that minimum when the declared value is lower.

Assumptions.transport_not_in_tax_base: Unfilled freight or insurance is not included in the tax base. This estimate uses the vehicle price and known charges; adding quotes recalculates it.
Assumptions.am_electric_relief_assumed: Electric-car figures assume the reference 2026 relief scenario. Quota, production year and eligibility require confirmation; zero tax does not guarantee exemption.
Assumptions.kg_electric_standard_duty: Electric/series-hybrid figures assume the standard 15% duty without quota relief. Confirm quota availability and eligibility for the clearance date.
Assumptions.ru_personal_relief_assumed: The recycling charge assumes the lower personal-use coefficients. Actual concession eligibility requires confirmation.
Assumptions.ru_erev_hybrid_assumed: Range-extenders provisionally follow the hybrid combustion-engine route. Confirm the vehicle classification and applicable power measurement.
